_meta.description: JMG MyGEMS open-data catalog for Malaysia (Malaysian geological map infrastructure). Discover live Map Services and Feature Services from Jabatan Mineral dan Geosains Malaysia (JMG) via the MyGEMS ArcGIS portal. Each service is queryable via the standard ArcGIS REST API; Feature Services additionally support direct export to Shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV, FileGDB, SQLite without authentication.
_meta.compiled_by: GEOX zen audit 2026-08-26 (background-agent research + reality probe)
_meta.license_summary: Open Government Data Malaysia / Educational & Scientific Research (CC-BY 4.0 compatible) — same provenance as macrostrat-ingestion/SUBMISSION_PROPOSAL.md
_meta.probe_method: ArcGIS Sharing REST API: https://mygems.jmg.gov.my/portal/sharing/rest/search?q=type:"Map Service"&f=json and FeatureService variant. Paged via start=1,num=50 until empty.

map_services.title: Geologi Asas Awam / Litology_by_Negeri
map_services.layers_summary: 14 states × {lithology, rock_age} pairs = 28, plus Sabah {lithology, rock_age} and Sarawak {lithology, rock_age} = 30 total. WKID 3857.
map_services.use_case: Canonical 1:500k bedrock geology substrate. Same source as macrostrat-ingestion packet (PR-ready to UW-Macrostrat).

map_services.title: Major Fault Malaysia
map_services.layers_summary: Single layer 'Major Fault' (id=5). Includes Bentong-Raub Suture, Bukit Tinggi Fault, Bok Bak Fault.
map_services.use_case: Major structural lineaments; tectonic domain attribution for seismic interpretation.

map_services.title: Active Fault Malaysia
map_services.layers_summary: Active faults (Quaternary slip). Separate from Major Fault which includes all ages.
map_services.use_case: Seismic hazard; NaTSIS integration with geox_temporal.

map_services.title: Geologi Marin Awam
map_services.layers_summary: id=0 Geophysical Survey Line Semenanjung; id=1 Geophysical Survey Line Sabah_Sarawak; id=2 Marine Geophysical Survey Area Semenanjung; id=3 Marine Geophysical Survey Area Sabah_Sarawak.
map_services.use_case: Onshore ↔ offshore correlation; complements NW Sabah / Malay Basin offshore work.

map_services.title: Sumber Mineral Awam
map_services.layers_summary: Mineral deposit locations by type × region: Metallic (Peninsular + Sabah/Sarawak), Energy, Strategic, Industrial minerals.
map_services.use_case: Prospect-scale mineral evidence; complements geox_prospect screen mode.

map_services.title: Groundwater Well Semenanjung 2025
map_services.layers_summary: Peninsular Malaysia public+private wells. Fresh 2025 ingest.
map_services.use_case: Cross-organ substrate for WELL federation organ (Phase 1-2 work).

map_services.title: Groundwater Well Sabah Sarawak 2025
map_services.layers_summary: Sabah + Sarawak public+private wells. Fresh 2025 ingest.
map_services.use_case: Borneo groundwater substrate.

map_services.title: Air Bawah Tanah Awam
map_services.layers_summary: General groundwater (older than 2025 services).
map_services.use_case: Historical groundwater baseline.

map_services.title: Geofizik Awam
map_services.layers_summary: Ground Magnetic, Resistivity, Magnetotelluric, TEM surveys.
map_services.use_case: Subsurface geophysics substrate for geox_subsurface_model and geox_geomechanics.

map_services.title: Geowarisan Awam
map_services.layers_summary: Geosites + Geoparks (8 layers).
map_services.use_case: Geoheritage documentation; not directly a geoscience substrate but useful for outreach layers.

map_services.title: Lombong Kuari Awam
map_services.layers_summary: Mines + Quarries.
map_services.use_case: Active mining footprint overlay; relevant to geox_prospect environmental context.

map_services.title: Demarcation MIL1
map_services.layers_summary: MIL1 demarcation boundaries.
map_services.use_case: Boundary reference; verify access tier before ingesting.

map_services.title: Seismik A MRSO
map_services.layers_summary: Seismic survey polygons (Peninsular).
map_services.use_case: Survey polygon metadata; not raw trace data.

map_services.title: Seismik A BRSO
map_services.layers_summary: BRSO seismic surveys (Borneo). FeatureServer — no sub-layers in metadata.
map_services.note: Listed in FeatureServer census; MapServer twin may or may not exist.
map_services.use_case: Borneo seismic survey footprint.

map_services.title: Seismic Hazard Map of Peninsular Malaysia (NaTSIS)
map_services.layers_summary: Single sub-layer MapServer/0. Hosted under NaTSIS server realm (different auth).
map_services.use_case: Seismic hazard zonation; geox_temporal hazard mode.

map_services.title: Seismic Hazard Map of Borneo (NaTSIS)
map_services.layers_summary: Borneo seismic hazard counterpart.
map_services.use_case: Borneo seismic hazard zonation.

map_services.title: Kawasan Liputan Pemetaan Geologi Terrain Sabah dan Sarawak
map_services.layers_summary: Borneo PGT coverage polygon (where mapping exists).
map_services.use_case: Coverage metadata — tells you which areas have terrain mapping vs gaps.

map_services.title: Kawasan Liputan Pemetaan Geologi Terrain Semenanjung
map_services.layers_summary: Peninsular PGT coverage.
map_services.use_case: Peninsular coverage metadata.

map_services.title: Amblesan Semenanjung (Landslide Peninsular)
map_services.layers_summary: Landslide profiles, Peninsular Malaysia.
map_services.use_case: Geohazard substrate for surface stability context.

map_services.title: Amblesan Sabah Sarawak (Landslide Borneo)
map_services.layers_summary: Landslide profiles, Sabah + Sarawak.
map_services.use_case: Borneo geohazard substrate.

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/Geofizik Awam - 2025 (Geophysics 2025)
feature_services_substantive.note: Twin of Geofizik_Awam MapServer; richer / newer.

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/Data_Rizab_Mineral
feature_services_substantive.note: Mineral reserves (distinct from occurrences in Sumber_Mineral).

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/Rizab_Mineral
feature_services_substantive.note: Duplicate of Data_Rizab_Mineral — verify before double-counting.

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/Bentong, Pahang, Pekan, eastjhr1, Points, STATE_PAHANG
feature_services_substantive.note: Place-name keyed datasets — likely raw working data, not curated. Verify provenance before use.

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/GeoExplore Race Data
feature_services_substantive.note: Outreach / gamification dataset, not geoscience substrate.

feature_services_substantive.title: Hosted/Ulasan
feature_services_substantive.note: Review/comments dataset. Low geo value but useful for change-tracking.

feature_services_excluded.rationale: Survey123 form backends are user-input forms (registration, surveys, feedback), not geoscience data. ~50 of the 77 Feature Services fall in this category.

global_query_template.rate_limits: Not documented; use conservative pagination (pageSize=1000, max 5000 features per request per ArcGIS default)

macrostrat_relationship.notes: This catalog extends the macrostrat ingestion packet. The macrostrat packet covers only the bedrock geology layers (Litology_by_Negeri). The catalog here documents the full JMG MyGEMS footprint for downstream GEOX tool development.
